hypothesis_candidates.baseline: At the identical held-position decision timestamp, keep the same cash-equity notional through H5 under the current canonical lifecycle behavior.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: Map the frozen hard_stop or high_urgency advisory state to a bounded default-off paper reduce-or-exit action, without changing entry ranking, sizing or live orders.
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: A high-severity lifecycle deterioration may persist after the first advisory; bounded de-risking can avoid adverse continuation, while explicit winner-collateral and slot-reuse accounting prevents apparent value created by simply selling winners or freeing capital.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: same held notional left unchanged over the identical H5 clock, with cash, SPY and QQQ context plus explicit slot-reuse and winner-collateral accounting
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: Existing long cash-equity positions only; no new notional, leverage, shorting or live order; at most one bounded action per name per session; stale or missing advisory state fails closed; trade_enabled=false; portfolio/name/sector caps unchanged.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Reject readiness if hard-stop decisions remain below 33, advisory decisions below 60, five executable treatment touches per standard window are not machine-proved, concentration or winner-collateral bars fail, or shared-helper parity is absent.
hypothesis_candidates.readiness: 429/422 total settled passes, but 26/33 hard-stop and 47/60 advisory do not; nineteen advisory rows remain pending and no 5/5/5 historical touch proof is bound.
